RESEARCH EXPERIENCE
zh: 研究经历

en: Nationwide Spatiotemporal Graph Study of Chinese Traditional Villages
zh: 中国传统村落全国尺度时空图研究

en: Southeast University  |  Ongoing research
zh: 东南大学 | 在研

en: •  Contributed to a nationwide research dataset covering 8,155 traditional villages, integrating building footprints, roads and multi-temporal remote-sensing evidence (2015, 2020 and 2025).
zh: • 参与构建覆盖8,155个传统村落的全国性研究数据集，整合建筑轮廓、道路与2015、2020、2025年多时相遥感证据。

en: •  Modelled building–road configurations as heterogeneous graphs; applied a Siamese relational GNN (R-GCN) with 256-dimensional village embeddings to learn pairwise similarities concerning geographical, cultural and industrial contexts.
zh: • 将建筑与道路构型表示为异构图；采用孪生关系图神经网络（R-GCN）与256维村落嵌入，学习地理、文化与产业语境下的成对相似性。

en: •  Compared hand-crafted form/typology descriptors with learned graph representations to examine when visible morphological resemblance agrees or diverges from relational similarity.
zh: • 比较人工构建的形态与类型描述指标和学习得到的图表示，分析可见形态相似性与关系相似性的一致与分歧。

en: •  Historical observations are retrospective for spatial features observable in 2025; they do not constitute complete inventories of features that disappeared earlier.
zh: • 历史观测是对2025年可观测空间要素的回溯，不构成对早期已消失要素的完整清单。
